title: Frame Engine is live!
author: melonboy55
selftext:
[Frameengine.ai](http://Frameengine.ai)  
I’ve been working on this since i quit my job in May! There’s a long way left to go, but I think it’s ready for people to start using it to make games.  
  
Frame Engine is an ai tool for making game character animations. It uses specially trained models to pose the characters and then animate them to do very specific motions. I’m charging money based on use. Each motion costs about 38 cents to generate - should  take about \~3 minutes total.  
  
Before you pay me anything! You need to be aware of what you're getting into - If you are expecting a tool that can generate any character animation perfectly, this is not for you, don’t pay for this. This app can be helpful for specific use cases, but it’s not a magic bullet.  
  
Limitations:

* There are only six motions right now. The app cannot really do anything besides ‘run’, ‘walk’, ‘jump’, ‘punch’, ‘fall down’, ‘stand up’. (let me know what other motions would be useful)
* The ‘run’ and ‘jump’ motions are not great. These were rushed a bit. I’ll have to go back and redo them.
* Motions are all platformer/sidescroller - there’s no top down support (yet)
* Motions cannot be customized, you can’t use a prompt to nudge the motion in one direction or another, pretty much all characters will do almost exactly the same punch etc. (working on this but it will take some time)
* There is no free trial! the minimum payment is $5. (also working on this)
* The models don’t handle props that well. (swords and staffs)
* not all art styles will be handled perfectly, pixel art characters might move strangely for example.

I’m working hard to build a real solution that can handle any character animation in a flexible and customizable way. I think what i have is less than 20% of that - but it’s reached a point where it can really help people make games. I hope it’s helpful to you!  
  
If you use the app, let me know what you think! DM me bugs, issues, or any feedback at all.
